title: Israel’s Election, Through the Eyes of a Young Palestinian

sentences.en: For Palestinians on the West Bank, Benjamin Netanyahu's promise to assert sovereignty over dozens of Jewish
sentences.zh: 对于西岸的巴勒斯坦人来说，本雅明·内塔尼亚胡承诺对当地数十个犹太

sentences.en: settlements there could mean the end of a decades-long struggle for a state of their own.
sentences.zh: 定居点主张主权，这可能意味着他们为建立自己的国家而奋斗了几十年的努力将付诸东流。

sentences.en: Today, the perspective of one young man, Fedi Koran, living on the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来听听一位住在西岸的年轻人费迪·科兰的视角。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月12日，星期五。

sentences.en: So, Fedi, tell me about growing up in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 那么，费迪，跟我讲讲你在西岸的成长经历吧。

sentences.en: Give me a sense of your life there as a kid.
sentences.zh: 让我感受一下你小时候在那里的生活。

sentences.en: Growing up in the West Bank is kind of a paradox because I grew up in this loving community and lived a lot of time with my grandparents.
sentences.zh: 在西岸成长是一种矛盾的体验，因为我是在一个充满爱的社区长大的，而且花了很多时间与祖父母在一起。

sentences.en: My grandmother would carry me on her shoulders and just walk around town, do shopping, do her farming and different pieces of her life.
sentences.zh: 我祖母会把我扛在肩上，在镇上到处走，去购物、干农活，处理她生活中的各种琐事。

sentences.en: And it's the type of place where literally you know everyone and everyone knows you.
sentences.zh: 那是一个你认识所有人，所有人也都认识你的地方。

sentences.en: Like, you know the baker down the street.
sentences.zh: 比如，你认识街那头的面包师。

sentences.en: You know the people who are doing the cleaning in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 你认识社区里负责打扫卫生的人。

sentences.en: You know the people who are producing the vegetables that you're buying.
sentences.zh: 你认识那些生产你所购买蔬菜的人。

sentences.en: At the same time, though, on every side of my village, there was an Israeli settlement.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我村庄的四面八方都有以色列定居点。

sentences.en: Like many settlements, Bet El started out as a few caravans on a hilltop.
sentences.zh: 像许多定居点一样，伯特利定居点最初只是山顶上的几辆大篷车。

sentences.en: The settlements are kind of like militarized suburbs where people come you don't know from where.
sentences.zh: 定居点就像是军事化的郊区，人们从你不知道的地方搬来。

sentences.en: They come from different countries, many from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们来自不同的国家，许多人来自美国。

sentences.en: One study estimates 15% of the settlers in the West Bank are American.
sentences.zh: 一项研究估计，西岸15%的定居者是美国人。

sentences.en: And they all believe that it is their right to be here.
sentences.zh: 他们都认为留在这里是他们的权利。

sentences.en: And then suddenly you don't have access to that area.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，你就无法进入那个区域了。

sentences.en: Settlements are built on land the Palestinians hope will be part of their future state.
sentences.zh: 定居点建在巴勒斯坦人希望成为他们未来国家一部分的土地上。

sentences.en: Now the efforts of all who have labored before us bring us to this moment.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们所有前辈的努力将我们带到了这一刻。

sentences.en: And what was happening in Palestine was there was supposed to be a priest process.
sentences.zh: 当时巴勒斯坦正在发生的事情是，本应有一个和平进程。

sentences.en: The Israeli and the Palestinian peoples who fought each other for almost a century have agreed to move decisively on the path of dialogue, understanding and cooperation.
sentences.zh: 几乎交战了一个世纪的以色列和巴勒斯坦人民，已经同意在对话、理解与合作的道路上果断前行。

sentences.en: That eventually said, OK, you're going to have your own state.
sentences.zh: 那最终意味着，好吧，你们将拥有自己的国家。

sentences.en: You can do whatever you want with it.
sentences.zh: 你们可以用它做任何想做的事。

sentences.en: The security of the Israeli people will be reconciled with the hopes of the Palestinian people.
sentences.zh: 以色列人民的安全将与巴勒斯坦人民的希望达成和解。

sentences.en: And there will be more security and more hope for all.
sentences.zh: 所有人都会拥有更多的安全和希望。

sentences.en: And what I remember kind of the conversation being on the dinner table and with the family and stuff is
sentences.zh: 我记得当时餐桌上和家人谈论的话题是，

sentences.en: everyone saying this is another trick because as the peace talks were happening, we were looking outside of our window and we were seeing it being demolished
sentences.zh: 每个人都说这又是另一个骗局，因为在和平谈判进行的同时，我们看着窗外，看到我们的土地正在被拆毁，

sentences.en: where we were supposedly supposed to get freedom and not have any more land taken from us.
sentences.zh: 而我们本应在那里获得自由，不再有土地被夺走。

sentences.en: So everyone was kind of in the sense of this is like nothing's going to come out of this.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都觉得，这根本不会有什么结果。

sentences.en: We were never going to get peace.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不会得到和平。

sentences.en: And instead, more and more of our land, more and more of what we consider to be Palestine was just going to be eaten away by these kind of settlers.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们更多的土地，更多我们认为是巴勒斯坦的地方，都要被这些定居者蚕食殆尽。

sentences.en: They're never going to give us our freedom.
sentences.zh: 他们永远不会给我们自由。

sentences.en: It was like enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 这简直是忍无可忍。

sentences.en: The future of Israeli PLO peace talks has once again been thrown into question.
sentences.zh: 以色列与巴解组织和平谈判的未来再次受到质疑。

sentences.en: This time by a suicide bombing that ripped through two buses.
sentences.zh: 这一次是因为一起炸毁两辆公共汽车的自杀式爆炸袭击。

sentences.en: This is the Intifada.
sentences.zh: 这就是起义。

sentences.en: This is the Intifada.
sentences.zh: 这就是起义。

sentences.en: The protests evolved from boys throwing rocks and people marching to fighters attacking Israeli soldiers and military targets.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动从男孩投掷石块和人们游行，演变成了武装人员袭击以色列士兵和军事目标。

sentences.en: And so you're hearing President Clinton in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以你听到美国总统克林顿

sentences.en: say that a two-state solution is on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 说“两国方案”指日可待。

sentences.en: But you can see in your own backyard how far away that actually seeMs.
sentences.zh: 但你可以在自己的后院看到，这实际上看起来有多么遥远。

sentences.en: And for young Palestinians like you, that was a turning point.
sentences.zh: 对于像你这样的年轻巴勒斯坦人来说，那是一个转折点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And were you drawn to the Intifada and to groups like Fatah or Hamas as a teenager while all this was happening?
sentences.zh: 在你十几岁时，当这一切发生时，你是否被起义以及像法塔赫或哈马斯这样的组织所吸引？

sentences.en: What happened was I started playing football and I got recruited by this team at one of the mosques.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况是，我开始踢足球，被清真寺的一支球队招募了。

sentences.en: And the goal of that recruitment was eventually to be brought into one of the Islamic parties here, Hamas.
sentences.zh: 招募的目标最终是把我带入这里的伊斯兰政党之一，即哈马斯。

sentences.en: For many people, they see these parties and sometimes they romanticize them because they see them from outside and they want to get in.
sentences.zh: 许多人看到这些政党时，有时会美化它们，因为他们是从外部观察的，并想加入其中。

sentences.en: And I had this chance of being courted by them.
sentences.zh: 我有机会被他们拉拢。

sentences.en: And so I saw them from the inside first, what they think and how they operate and their goals.
sentences.zh: 所以我先从内部观察了他们，了解了他们的想法、运作方式和目标。

sentences.en: And it just, I couldn't trust any of the parties.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，我无法信任任何一个政党。

sentences.en: They didn't inspire me.
sentences.zh: 他们没有激励我。

sentences.en: And although I wanted to be politically active, what I saw on the inside was extremely dysfunctional, autocratic movements.
sentences.zh: 虽然我想参与政治，但我从内部看到的是极其功能失调、独裁的运动。

sentences.en: That's how I felt like they were not investing in me because they wanted me to do something great.
sentences.zh: 我感觉他们并不是因为想让我成就伟业而投资我。

sentences.en: They were investing in me because they wanted to use me to achieve their own means.
sentences.zh: 他们投资我，是因为想利用我来实现他们自己的目的。

sentences.en: And that just meant that I left all of them disenchanted by them.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我离开了他们所有人，对他们感到幻灭。

sentences.en: And I started to, with my friends and I think a lot of Palestinians of my generation at that time, we began to want to create our own types of movements.
sentences.zh: 我和朋友们，我想当时我那一代的许多巴勒斯坦人，开始想要创造我们自己类型的运动。

sentences.en: Yes, we, you know, we really wanted to be part of the Antifalda, but at least in my case, it wasn't through the political parties.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们确实想参与起义，但至少在我的情况下，不是通过政党。

sentences.en: It was separate from them.
sentences.zh: 而是独立于他们之外。

sentences.en: Were there aspects of life as a teenager that felt normal, that didn't feel defined by this conflict and by this geopolitical situation?
sentences.zh: 在你十几岁的生活中，有没有什么方面让你觉得正常，没有被这种冲突和地缘政治局势所定义？

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 有的，当然有。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, we'd go to the movies, like we had a very small theater, looks more like a university classroom, you know, a few, like maybe 20 seats and a projector.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们会去看电影，我们有一个非常小的剧院，看起来更像大学教室，可能只有20个座位和一个投影仪。

sentences.en: You know, if you had the girlfriend, that was like the place to take her.
sentences.zh: 如果你有女朋友，那就是带她去的地方。

sentences.en: And, you know, in that setting, while you're watching the movie, eating popcorn, like everything happening in the world around you disappears.
sentences.zh: 在那种环境下，当你看着电影、吃着爆米花时，周围世界发生的一切都会消失。

sentences.en: And you're just a young teenager.
sentences.zh: 你只是一个年轻的少年。

sentences.en: Did you have a favorite movie as a teenager?
sentences.zh: 你十几岁时有最喜欢的电影吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, actually, in terms of American movies, my favorite movie was A Beautiful Mind.
sentences.zh: 有，事实上，在美国电影中，我最喜欢的是《美丽心灵》。

sentences.en: Mathematicians won the war.
sentences.zh: 数学家赢得了战争。

sentences.en: Mathematicians broke the Japanese codes and built the A-bomb.
sentences.zh: 数学家破译了日本的密码，制造了原子弹。

sentences.en: Mathematicians like you.
sentences.zh: 像你这样的数学家。

sentences.en: After I watched A Beautiful Mind, I just became infatuated with math and physics.
sentences.zh: 看完《美丽心灵》后，我就迷上了数学和物理。

sentences.en: Now, who among you will be the next Morse?
sentences.zh: 现在，你们中间谁会是下一个莫尔斯？

sentences.en: The next Einstein?
sentences.zh: 下一个爱因斯坦？

sentences.en: Who among you will be the vanguard of democracy, freedom and discovery?
sentences.zh: 你们中间谁会成为民主、自由和发现的先锋？

sentences.en: I began like downloading math books and physics books, you know, off of the internet or going to the library and getting them.
sentences.zh: 我开始从网上下载数学书和物理书，或者去图书馆借阅。

sentences.en: And like, you know, answering all these equations.
sentences.zh: 然后解答所有这些方程式。

sentences.en: And that was the way I think, you know, that I ran away from it.
sentences.zh: 我想，这就是我逃避现实的方式。

sentences.en: You know, one of the ways that people would leave the difficult reality that we were in was also just books.
sentences.zh: 人们逃避我们所处困境的一种方式也是读书。

sentences.en: Like, you know, one of the first books I read was Hawking's A Brief History of Time.
sentences.zh: 我读的第一本书之一就是霍金的《时间简史》。

sentences.en: And I just became enchanted with theoretical physics.
sentences.zh: 我被理论物理学深深吸引了。

sentences.en: And one day, we had this college counselor who was a volunteer from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我们有一位来自美国的志愿者大学顾问，

sentences.en: who had flown to Palestine.
sentences.zh: 他飞到了巴勒斯坦。

sentences.en: And he said, you enjoy physics a lot.
sentences.zh: 他说，你非常喜欢物理。

sentences.en: I think you should apply to this university in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你应该申请美国这所大学，

sentences.en: called Stanford because they're really good at physics.
sentences.zh: 叫斯坦福，因为他们的物理专业非常棒。

sentences.en: And I was like, sure, you know, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 我说，当然，我们试试吧。

sentences.en: And so he showed me how to do it.
sentences.zh: 于是他教我怎么申请。

sentences.en: And I applied, I got in, and that ended up taking me 9,000 miles away to Stanford in Silicon Valley in California.
sentences.zh: 我申请了，被录取了，这最终把我带到了9000英里外加州硅谷的斯坦福大学。

sentences.en: And I have to imagine that it was a huge adjustment going from the West Bank to Palo Alto, California.
sentences.zh: 我能想象，从西岸到加州帕洛阿尔托是一个巨大的调整。

sentences.en: It was a huge adjustment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的调整。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I was in this place where I could meet new people, including, you know, meet Jews in a situation where my whole life,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我身处一个可以结识新朋友的地方，包括在一种情况下结识犹太人，而我的一生中，

sentences.en: the only Jewish people I had known were either soldiers with guns or settlers with guns.
sentences.zh: 我认识的唯一犹太人要么是拿着枪的士兵，要么是拿着枪的定居者。

sentences.en: And so I'm in this new place and I'm so curious.
sentences.zh: 所以我到了这个新地方，我非常好奇。

sentences.en: And one of the first ideas that comes to my mind is I'm going to figure out the secret community and how they function.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中浮现的第一个想法是，我要找出这个秘密社区以及他们是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Of Jews.
sentences.zh: 犹太人的。

sentences.en: Of Jews.
sentences.zh: 犹太人的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, on U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国的校园里，有希勒尔社区中心，基本上就是犹太社区中心。

sentences.en: campuses, there's, you know, the community center Hillel, basically the like Jewish community center.
sentences.zh: 我没有去斯坦福的那一个，因为学生们会认出我。

sentences.en: So I didn't go to the one at Stanford because the students would know me.
sentences.zh: 但我去了附近另一所大学的希勒尔中心。

sentences.en: But I went to another Hillel at a university nearby.
sentences.zh: 我伪造了一个身份，基本上说，你好，我叫萨米·本·阿米。

sentences.en: I create a fake identity and I basically said, hi, my name is Sami bin Ami.
sentences.zh: 我是一名伊拉克犹太人，我和家人刚逃离伊拉克。

sentences.en: I'm an Iraqi Jew and my family and I just fled Iraq.
sentences.zh: 但在那里时，我们无法了解犹太教的含义。

sentences.en: But while we were there, we could never learn about what Judaism means.
sentences.zh: 我们也无法了解以色列，因为我们生活在萨达姆那个可怕的独裁统治下。

sentences.en: And we could never learn about Israel because we were under this horrible dictatorship called Saddam.
sentences.zh: 你们能收留我并教我一切吗？

sentences.en: And can you please kind of take me in and teach me everything?
sentences.zh: 我当时有一种詹姆斯·邦德式的个性。

sentences.en: And, you know, I had this kind of like James Bond type of personality.
sentences.zh: 我想从内部了解他们。

sentences.en: It's like, I'm going to understand them from the inside.
sentences.zh: 我想从内部了解这是如何运作的。

sentences.en: I'm going to understand how this works from within.
sentences.zh: 你认为是什么动机促使你这样做？

sentences.en: And what do you think was motivating you here to do this?
sentences.zh: 你是想了解敌人，或者至少是你在西岸所认识的敌人吗？

sentences.en: Did you want to know the enemy or at least the enemy as you knew them in the West Bank?
sentences.zh: 还是你想更好地了解犹太教？

sentences.en: Or did you want to better understand Judaism?
sentences.zh: 或者是别的什么？

sentences.en: Or what exactly?
sentences.zh: 两者都有吧。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a bit of both.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是我想渗透进这个社区，弄清楚他们是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Part of it was like, I want to infiltrate this community and figure out like, how do they function?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们要对我们做这些事？

sentences.en: And why are they doing what they're doing to us?
sentences.zh: 他们对我们所作所为背后的意识形态是什么？

sentences.en: And what's the ideology behind what they're doing to us?
sentences.zh: 另一部分原因只是我一直对学习新事物很好奇。

sentences.en: And part of it was just like, I've always been like curious about learning new things.
sentences.zh: 这是我喜欢的事情。

sentences.en: It's something that I enjoy.
sentences.zh: 所以我来到这里，试图渗透并了解这一切。

sentences.en: So here I am coming in trying to like infiltrate and learn about this thing.
sentences.zh: 我发现了一个与我成长环境相似的社区，充满了爱、联系和对他人的关怀，他们完全接纳了我。

sentences.en: And I find a community that's similar to the community that I grew up in, you know, full of love and connection and care for one another that took me in completely.
sentences.zh: 他们说，嘿，好吧，你有安息日。

sentences.en: And they were like, hey, OK, so you have Shabbat.
sentences.zh: 你需要来。

sentences.en: You need to come.
sentences.zh: 我每周都和他们一起吃晚餐，学习宗教知识，我只是交朋友，最终你开始与这些人建立联系。

sentences.en: And like I'd have dinners with them every week and like learn about the religion and learn about I just make friends, you know, like eventually you begin to connect to the people.
sentences.zh: 但疯狂的是，有一天他们告诉我，以色列领事馆正在为犹太裔美国新生进行培训，教他们如何捍卫以色列。

sentences.en: But the crazy thing was that one day they told me the Israeli consulate is doing a training for like Jewish American freshmen on how to defend Israel.
sentences.zh: 他们问，萨米，你想去吗？

sentences.en: And they were like, Sami, do you want to go?
sentences.zh: 我说，当然，帮我报名。

sentences.en: And I was like, of course, sign me up.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我想，中大奖了，现在我可以深入系统内部了。

sentences.en: And here, you know, I think jackpot, like now I'm going to be really deep into the system.
sentences.zh: 我去了，他们做的第一件事就是教我们大屠杀的历史。

sentences.en: And I go and the first thing they do is they teach you about the HolocauSt.
sentences.zh: 我当时泪流满面。

sentences.en: And I was in tears.
sentences.zh: 那里的每个人都泪流满面。

sentences.en: Everyone there was in tears.
sentences.zh: 我们看了一部很长的纪录片。

sentences.en: We watched like this long documentary.
sentences.zh: 第二天，在那种悲伤的情绪之后，有人告诉我们：

sentences.en: And then the second day, you know, after you're in that sense of like sorrow, you're told.
sentences.zh: 但从灰烬中，新的以色列国崛起了。

sentences.en: But out of the ashes, the new state of Israel arose.
sentences.zh: 现在国家负责我们的安全，它将从现在到永远保护我们的安全。

sentences.en: And now the state is responsible for our security and it will keep us safe from now until forever.
sentences.zh: 现在国家负责我们的安全，它将从现在到永远保护我们的安全。

sentences.en: So for me, of course, as like a secret Palestinian, I was like, oh, so this is what they're told about, you know, what Israel means and so forth.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，作为一个“秘密”巴勒斯坦人，我当时想，哦，原来这就是他们被灌输的关于以色列的意义等等。

sentences.en: But for everyone else in that group, they were like, yeah, you know, this is amazing.
sentences.zh: 但对小组里的其他人来说，他们觉得，哇，这太棒了。

sentences.en: I want to go and be part of the IDF.
sentences.zh: 我想去参加以色列国防军。

sentences.en: People felt the sense of like pride and security.
sentences.zh: 人们感到一种自豪感和安全感。

sentences.en: And then the final bit of the training is they say, we are still under threat.
sentences.zh: 训练的最后一部分是他们说，我们仍然处于威胁之中。

sentences.en: You should still be afraid because there are evil people everywhere that still want to destroy us.
sentences.zh: 你们仍然应该感到害怕，因为到处都有邪恶的人想要摧毁我们。

sentences.en: And then they put an image of someone who, you know, looks kind of like me, Middle Eastern, wearing the kofiyya, you know, that white and black scarf,
sentences.zh: 然后他们放了一张照片，照片上的人看起来有点像我，中东人，戴着库菲亚，就是那种黑白相间的头巾，

sentences.en: like Yasser Arafat wore on his head.
sentences.zh: 就像亚西尔·阿拉法特头上戴的那种。

sentences.en: And they say, even on your campuses, you're going to find students.
sentences.zh: 他们说，即使在你们的校园里，也会有这样的学生。

sentences.en: And these students are going to say things like the settlements are bad and they take people's land.
sentences.zh: 这些学生会说定居点是不好的，他们占领了人们的土地之类的话。

sentences.en: How exactly are you feeling in this moment?
sentences.zh: 你现在到底是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Because it sounds like you found yourself in a very complicated position where you've come to care about these Jewish students.
sentences.zh: 因为听起来你发现自己处于一个非常复杂的境地，你开始关心这些犹太学生了。

sentences.en: But you're seeing photos in which they are now being presented with someone like you as a threat.
sentences.zh: 但你却看到照片里，他们被灌输说像你这样的人是威胁。

sentences.en: As basically like the enemy.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是把你们当成敌人。

sentences.en: And of course, if they feel like people like me are the enemy and if they feel like they're under threat,
sentences.zh: 当然，如果他们觉得像我这样的人是敌人，如果他们觉得受到了威胁，

sentences.en: especially given the huge trauma that they and their families have been through because of anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 尤其是考虑到他们和他们的家人因反犹主义而遭受的巨大创伤，

sentences.en: Well, of course, this is the reason they act this way.
sentences.zh: 那么，这当然就是他们会有这种行为的原因。

sentences.en: And it kind of created so much more nuance in my head because growing up, it was just like, these people are bad.
sentences.zh: 这在我的脑海中产生了很多细微的差别，因为在成长过程中，我只是觉得这些人是坏人。

sentences.en: I should be aware and afraid of them because look at what they're doing to me without understanding why they were doing it.
sentences.zh: 我应该意识到并害怕他们，因为看看他们对我做了什么，却不理解他们为什么要这样做。

sentences.en: So suddenly you're seeing why the other side, the Jewish side, feels this same intense sense of need as you do for a state of their own.
sentences.zh: 所以你突然明白了为什么另一方，即犹太一方，和你一样，对拥有一个属于自己的国家有着同样强烈的需求感。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I see why they believe that this is so necessary.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我明白他们为什么认为这如此必要。

sentences.en: Doesn't mean that it made me feel like it was justified.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着我觉得这是合理的。

sentences.en: I just finally understood where it was coming from.
sentences.zh: 我只是终于理解了这种想法的来源。

sentences.en: It wasn't coming from a black hole.
sentences.zh: 它不是凭空产生的。

sentences.en: So after college, do you eventually go back home to the West Bank?
sentences.zh: 那么大学毕业后，你最终回到了西岸的家吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So what happened was I had decided to go to law school right after college in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，我决定在美国大学毕业后直接去读法学院。

sentences.en: And I come back home just for the summer break.
sentences.zh: 我只是在暑假回了一趟家。

sentences.en: And I'm, you know, I'm at home with my family.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我和家人待在一起。

sentences.en: A plumber and his son come to our house to do some plumbing.
sentences.zh: 一个水管工带着他的儿子来我们家修理管道。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's a young kid, but I'm like, why aren't you in school?
sentences.zh: 那是个小孩子，但我问他，你为什么不去上学？

sentences.en: And he's like, well, we live in this village and it's very hard to get to my school.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们住在这个村子里，去学校非常困难。

sentences.en: And my father said, given that it's so hard for me to get to school and I'm missing too many classes, he's just going to teach me how to be a plumber like him.
sentences.zh: 我父亲说，既然去学校太难了，而且我落下了太多课，他干脆教我做个像他一样的水管工。

sentences.en: And so I said, well, I'm sorry, but, you know, do you want me to give you some classes, given that you're going to be working here for the next couple of days?
sentences.zh: 所以我说，抱歉，既然你接下来的几天都要在这里工作，你想让我给你补补课吗？

sentences.en: Once you're done, I can give you some classes.
sentences.zh: 等你忙完了，我可以教你一些课程。

sentences.en: But like, what's your favorite subject?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

sentences.en: And he was like, math.
sentences.zh: 他说，数学。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The only books I had were, you know, like three, four years more advanced than his age.
sentences.zh: 我当时手头唯一的书，比他的年龄深奥三四年级。

sentences.en: But I gave him classes and gave him the books that I had.
sentences.zh: 但我还是给他上了课，并把我的书给了他。

sentences.en: And he's gone for a few weeks, but then he comes back and he's like, here's your book back.
sentences.zh: 他走了几周，但后来他回来了，说，书还给你。

sentences.en: And I answered all of the questions and I go through the book and I'll be like, I'm like amazed.
sentences.zh: 我把所有问题都答完了，我翻看那本书，感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: I'm like, you're a genius.
sentences.zh: 我说，你真是个天才。

sentences.en: Like, do you understand?
sentences.zh: 你明白吗？

sentences.en: You know, I called his father.
sentences.zh: 我给他父亲打了电话。

sentences.en: I was like, you don't understand.
sentences.zh: 我说，你不明白。

sentences.en: Like your son needs to go back to school.
sentences.zh: 你的儿子需要回到学校去。

sentences.en: He's really smart.
sentences.zh: 他真的很聪明。

sentences.en: But that moment made me reconsider.
sentences.zh: 但那一刻让我重新思考。

sentences.en: Like, I realized I had been very lucky to have gone to Stanford and been in Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 我意识到我非常幸运，能去斯坦福大学，能在硅谷待过。

sentences.en: But I had been away too long from Palestine.
sentences.zh: 但我离开巴勒斯坦太久了。

sentences.en: And where my passion really was, was I never wanted any other kid like this young kid, Muhammad, to go through life with so much potential and not even know it.
sentences.zh: 我真正的热情所在，是我再也不想让任何像穆罕默德这样的小孩，带着如此巨大的潜力却甚至意识不到地度过一生。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to come back and make sure that that didn't happen to anyone.
sentences.zh: 我只是想回来，确保这种事不会发生在任何人身上。

sentences.en: So you decided to stay.
sentences.zh: 所以你决定留下来。

sentences.en: I decided to stay.
sentences.zh: 我决定留下来。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And what is your life like today in the West Bank?
sentences.zh: 你今天在西岸的生活是怎样的？

sentences.en: So I live in the same neighborhood that I grew up in.
sentences.zh: 我住在我长大的同一个社区。

sentences.en: And today when I wake up and I step outside the house to go for my morning run, I see that the settlement literally doubled in size.
sentences.zh: 今天当我醒来，走出家门去晨跑时，我看到定居点的规模简直翻了一倍。

sentences.en: And I see soldiers, you know, standing at the entrance of the checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 我看到士兵们站在检查站的入口处。

sentences.en: This time they're standing and they don't seem as worried.
sentences.zh: 这次他们站在那里，看起来并不那么担心。

sentences.en: They seem like everything's under control.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来好像一切都在掌控之中。

sentences.en: They're watching the construction continue and they just seem bored.
sentences.zh: 他们看着建筑工程继续进行，看起来只是感到无聊。

sentences.en: And I see protests just like the protests that I participated in as a young child.
sentences.zh: 我看到了抗议活动，就像我小时候参加的那种。

sentences.en: And people are still protesting, but they're much lesser numbers.
sentences.zh: 人们仍然在抗议，但人数少多了。

sentences.en: Now as I walk into our city, it's been corrupted by not just Israeli occupation, but Palestinian
sentences.zh: 现在当我走进我们的城市，它不仅被以色列的占领所腐蚀，还被巴勒斯坦的

sentences.en: political leadership who they've become a dictatorship and they believe more in continuing to live the cushy life that they live today.
sentences.zh: 政治领导层所腐蚀，他们已经变成了独裁政权，他们更相信继续过他们今天这种舒适的生活。

sentences.en: And so people feel this sense of, I'd say, hopelessness.
sentences.zh: 所以人们感到一种，我想说是绝望感。

sentences.en: You grow up your whole life.
sentences.zh: 你一生都在成长。

sentences.en: And when you look around you, everywhere you go, it's worse.
sentences.zh: 当你环顾四周，无论走到哪里，情况都在变糟。

sentences.en: You don't even have the sense of community that once existed because it's gotten so bad that there's this sense of scarcity and individualism that it's everyone for themselves.
sentences.zh: 你甚至没有了曾经存在的社区意识，因为情况变得太糟了，以至于产生了一种匮乏感和个人主义，每个人都只顾自己。

sentences.en: So Fadi, I want to ask you about what happened this week.
sentences.zh: 法迪，我想问你关于这周发生的事情。

sentences.en: Israel has, as you know, voted to essentially reelect Benjamin Netanyahu as their prime minister once again.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，以色列投票决定再次选举本雅明·内塔尼亚胡为总理。

sentences.en: And as part of his promise in campaigning for re-election, he said he would annex Israeli settlements and make them officially part of Israel.
sentences.zh: 作为他竞选连任承诺的一部分，他说他将吞并以色列定居点，并使其正式成为以色列的一部分。

sentences.en: And a lot of people are saying that basically that spells the end of any kind of real two-state
sentences.zh: 很多人说这基本上意味着任何形式的真正“两国方案”的终结，

sentences.en: solution and the idea that the Palestinians will get the West Bank and their own state.
sentences.zh: 以及巴勒斯坦人将获得西岸并拥有自己国家的想法的终结。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you think about that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你怎么看。

sentences.en: You know, Michael, we've been living this creeping annexation every day.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你知道，我们每天都在经历这种“蚕食式吞并”。

sentences.en: So actually, when Netanyahu said they're going to do it, to me, it was like, thank God someone's finally saying it directly.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，当内塔尼亚胡说他们要这样做时，对我来说，就像是，感谢上帝，终于有人直接说出来了。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: You're not so troubled by it in the sense that you think it's him just saying what's already happening?
sentences.zh: 你对此并不感到困扰，因为你认为他只是在说已经发生的事情？

sentences.en: Yeah, he's saying what's already happening.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是在说已经发生的事情。

sentences.en: And, you know, this concept of gaslighting where people are doing something, but they keep telling you that something else is happening.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种“煤气灯效应”，人们在做某事，却一直告诉你发生了别的事情。

sentences.en: And they kind of make you lose your mind.
sentences.zh: 他们让你快要疯了。

sentences.en: This is what, for years now, we've been going through.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们多年来一直经历的事情。

sentences.en: We've known that Israel's plan has been to annex the land, take the settlements, kick us out even if possible.
sentences.zh: 我们一直知道以色列的计划是吞并土地，占领定居点，甚至可能的话把我们赶走。

sentences.en: But the fact that Netanyahu kind of now feels so comfortable to actually come out and say, you know what, world?
sentences.zh: 但内塔尼亚胡现在感觉如此自在，能够站出来说，你知道吗，世界？

sentences.en: We're just going to tell you the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们只是要告诉你们真相。

sentences.en: This is our plan.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的计划。

sentences.en: This is what we want to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们想做的。

sentences.en: Makes us actually say, thank you.
sentences.zh: 这反而让我们说，谢谢。

sentences.en: We, you know, we know this is the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这就是真相。

sentences.en: And hopefully everyone watching the international news will now see the reality.
sentences.zh: 希望所有观看国际新闻的人现在都能看到现实。

sentences.en: I guess I'm surprised that you see an opportunity in this moment when Israel is saying that it plans to annex West Bank settlements.
sentences.zh: 我想我很惊讶你在这个时刻看到了机会，尽管以色列说它计划吞并西岸定居点。

sentences.en: And they're basically finding a supportive ear in President Trump in the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在美国基本上得到了特朗普总统的支持。

sentences.en: What would you draw any hope from, given that situation?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，你会从哪里获得希望？

sentences.en: I mean, you're completely right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: Where's the hope?
sentences.zh: 希望在哪里？

sentences.en: It's hard to see any hope.
sentences.zh: 很难看到任何希望。

sentences.en: But if you actually look at the United States right now and the political atmosphere there,
sentences.zh: 但如果你看看现在的美国和那里的政治氛围，

sentences.en: even with Trump as president, you have American Jews who feel completely disconnected to the
sentences.zh: 即使特朗普是总统，你也有美国犹太人，他们感到与内塔尼亚胡推行的政策完全脱节，

sentences.en: large part from the policies that Netanyahu is pushing, that many of them see as fascist and contrary to Jewish beliefs.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为这些政策是法西斯主义的，违背了犹太信仰。

sentences.en: And you have some of the most watched congresswomen, whether it's Ilhan Omar.
sentences.zh: 而且你还有一些最受关注的女议员，比如伊尔汗·奥马尔。

sentences.en: And we mask it with a conversation that's about a two-state solution when you have policies that clearly prioritize one over the other.
sentences.zh: 当我们有明显优先考虑一方而非另一方的政策时，我们用关于“两国方案”的对话来掩盖它。

sentences.en: And so I am aggravated.
sentences.zh: 所以我很愤怒。

sentences.en: Or AOC.
sentences.zh: 或者AOC（亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯）。
zh_words: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: What people are starting to see, at least in the occupation of Palestine, is just an increasing crisis of humanitarian condition.
sentences.zh: 人们开始看到的，至少在巴勒斯坦被占领区，只是人道主义状况的日益危机。

sentences.en: Or Rashida Tlaib.
sentences.zh: 或者拉希达·特莱布。

sentences.en: Everybody there deserves to thrive, deserves to feel safe, deserves respect in the fact that
sentences.zh: 那里的每个人都应该茁壮成长，应该感到安全，应该得到尊重，事实上

sentences.en: they don't need to look the other way and all of a sudden be a victim of violent attacks on villages and people that are innocent.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要视而不见，突然成为针对村庄和无辜人民暴力袭击的受害者。

sentences.en: Are beginning to speak about this conflict in a different way.
sentences.zh: 她们开始以不同的方式谈论这场冲突。

sentences.en: And introducing a whole new type of narrative where they can easily say, we believe that Palestinians should be free.
sentences.zh: 并引入了一种全新的叙事方式，她们可以轻易地说，我们相信巴勒斯坦人应该自由。

sentences.en: Even Bernie Sanders, you know, you have the majority of Democratic presidential candidates
sentences.zh: 甚至伯尼·桑德斯，你知道，大多数民主党总统候选人

sentences.en: skipping AIPAC when just years ago, they would all go to AIPAC as if it was their high school prom.
sentences.zh: 都避开了AIPAC（美国以色列公共事务委员会），而就在几年前，他们还会像参加高中舞会一样去参加AIPAC。

sentences.en: Beneath the surface of what the Trump administration represents, there's something new rising.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府所代表的事物表面之下，有新的东西正在兴起。

sentences.en: So I see hope in that.
sentences.zh: 所以我从中看到了希望。

sentences.en: It's interesting to me that you see the Democratic Party in the United States as being part of what may change this dynamic.
sentences.zh: 你认为美国的民主党是可能改变这种动态的一部分，这很有趣。

sentences.en: Because whether it's Rashida Tlaib or Ilhan Omar, they have come under a tremendous amount of fire from their own party and from the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 因为无论是拉希达·特莱布还是伊尔汗·奥马尔，她们都受到了来自本党和共和党的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: And what they are saying is considered controversial.
sentences.zh: 她们所说的话被认为是具有争议的。

sentences.en: Does that worry you?
sentences.zh: 这让你担心吗？

sentences.en: The fact that they continue to speak and, you know, they're still there shows you that something is changing.
sentences.zh: 她们继续发言的事实，以及她们仍然在那里，向你表明有些事情正在改变。

sentences.en: Fetty, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 法迪，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: And I hope we get to speak again soon.
sentences.zh: 希望我们很快能再谈。

sentences.en: Thank you for giving me the opportunity to speak.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你给我这个发言的机会。

sentences.en: It's been a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 很高兴与你交谈。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the New York Post ran a cover story criticizing Representative Ilhan Omar for remarks
sentences.zh: 周四，《纽约邮报》刊登了一篇封面故事，批评众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔，因为她发表的言论

sentences.en: she had made seeming to minimize the September 11th terror attacks by describing them as, quote, some people did something.
sentences.zh: 似乎通过将9月11日恐怖袭击描述为“有些人做了一些事”来淡化袭击。

sentences.en: Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib was among the Democrats who came to Omar's defense on Thursday, saying,
sentences.zh: 众议员拉希达·特莱布是周四为奥马尔辩护的民主党人之一，她说，

sentences.en: quote, they take our words out of context because they're afraid, because we speak truth.
sentences.zh: “他们断章取义，因为他们害怕，因为我们在说真话。”

sentences.en: We speak truth to power.
sentences.zh: “我们在向权力说真话。”

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday, seven years after taking refuge in the Ecuadorian embassy in London, the founder of WikiLeaks, Julian Assange, was evicted by the Ecuadorian government,
sentences.zh: 周四，在伦敦厄瓜多尔大使馆避难七年后，维基解密创始人朱利安·阿桑奇被厄瓜多尔政府驱逐，

sentences.en: arrested by the British police, and charged by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 被英国警方逮捕，并被美国指控

sentences.en: with conspiring to hack into a government computer.
sentences.zh: 密谋入侵政府计算机。

sentences.en: Ecuador es un país generoso y de brazos abiertos.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔是一个慷慨且张开双臂的国家。

sentences.en: El nuestro es un gobierno respetuoso de los principios del derecho internacional, entre ellos la institución del asilo.
sentences.zh: 我们的政府尊重国际法原则，包括庇护制度。

sentences.en: In a video message, Ecuador's president said that Assange had exhausted his country's patience by, among other things,
sentences.zh: 在一段视频信息中，厄瓜多尔总统表示，阿桑奇耗尽了该国的耐心，原因包括

sentences.en: tampering with embassy security cameras and mistreating embassy guards.
sentences.zh: 篡改大使馆监控摄像头和虐待大使馆警卫。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国的

sentences.en: charge is connected to the 2010 publication by WikiLeaks of tens of thousands of secret government documents and carries a penalty of up to five years in prison.
sentences.zh: 指控与维基解密在2010年公布数万份秘密政府文件有关，最高可判处五年监禁。

sentences.en: And the president of Sudan, Omar al-Bashir, was overthrown and taken into custody by his nation's military.
sentences.zh: 苏丹总统奥马尔·巴希尔已被该国军方推翻并拘留。

sentences.en: Al-Bashir, who ruled modern Sudan longer than any other leader, was ousted after nearly four months of mass protests over corruption in his government and poor economic conditions.
sentences.zh: 巴希尔是现代苏丹执政时间最长的领导人，在经历了近四个月针对其政府腐败和经济状况恶劣的大规模抗议后，他被赶下了台。

sentences.en: During his 30-year reign, al-Bashir became known for brutal military tactics, including a murderous campaign to put down a rebellion in Darfur,
sentences.zh: 在他30年的统治期间，巴希尔以残酷的军事手段而闻名，包括一场旨在镇压达尔富尔叛乱的血腥行动，

sentences.en: which killed tens of thousands of civilians.
sentences.zh: 这场行动导致了数万名平民丧生。

sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》由西奥·巴尔科姆、安迪·米尔斯、丽莎·托宾、雷切尔·奎斯特、琳赛·加里森、安妮·布朗制作，

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro, listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听《地铁》。
